description: Every void-of-course Moon period between two dates (up to 62 days): start (the Moon's last exact Ptolemaic aspect to the Sun or a planet in its sign), end (entry into the next sign), length in hours, the last aspect and the signs. Computed live from the ephemeris (astronomy-engine, about 1′), tropical zodiac on the true ecliptic of date, geocentric, UTC. Astronomical positions only, no interpretation. Paid tool: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base via x402 (HTTP 402 with payment requirements; retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Free tools cover the current status and the next retrograde.

from.description: Range start, YYYY-MM-DD (start of day) or ISO UTC. Defaults to now.

to.description: Range end, YYYY-MM-DD (end of day) or ISO UTC. Defaults to 14 days after from.

name: void_of_course
title: Void-of-course Moon periods
